name: Brain Tissue Volume Estimation from MRI Stack
description:
Open the T1 Head MRI sample stack in Fiji (File > Open Samples > T1 Head (2.4MB, MRI)). This is a 256x256x129 slice T1-weighted MRI brain scan.

Your goal is to estimate the total brain tissue volume:
1. Apply an intensity threshold to segment brain tissue (bright regions) from background, CSF, and skull.
2. Measure the thresholded tissue area on each slice of the stack (or at minimum 20+ slices spanning the full range).
3. Compute a total brain tissue volume estimate by summing the per-slice areas.
4. Save all per-slice area measurements and the total volume estimate to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/mri_volume_results.csv.

The CSV must include:
- A slice number or identifier column
- Measured area per slice
- A total volume value (as a summary row, separate line, or header comment)

Note: In a real brain MRI, tissue area varies greatly across slices — near zero at the very top and bottom, maximal in the middle.
